SELECT w.gb_ai_workflow_id AS workflowId, sq.gb_ai_wsq_workflow_code AS workflowCode, w.gb_ai_workflow_enabled AS workflowEnabled, sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_id AS topicId, sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_title AS topicTitle, sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_description AS topicDescription, sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_sort AS topicSort, sq.gb_ai_wsq_question_code AS questionCode, sq.gb_ai_wsq_question_text AS questionText, sq.gb_ai_wsq_enabled AS enabled, sq.gb_ai_wsq_status AS status, sq.gb_ai_wsq_scene AS scene, sq.gb_ai_wsq_sort AS sort, sq.gb_ai_wsq_intent_hint AS intentHint, sq.gb_ai_wsq_contract_hint AS contractHint FROM gb_ai_workflow_suggested_question sq INNER JOIN gb_ai_workflow w ON w.gb_ai_workflow_id = sq.gb_ai_wsq_workflow_id INNER JOIN gb_ai_advisor_workflow aw ON aw.gb_ai_aw_workflow_id = w.gb_ai_workflow_id AND aw.gb_ai_aw_advisor_id = #{advisorId} WHERE sq.gb_ai_wsq_enabled = 1 AND sq.gb_ai_wsq_status <> 'DISABLED' AND ( (sq.gb_ai_wsq_status = 'ACTIVE' AND w.gb_ai_workflow_enabled = 1) OR sq.gb_ai_wsq_status = 'COMING_SOON' )
AND sq.gb_ai_wsq_question_code LIKE CONCAT(#{questionCodePrefix}, '%')
AND sq.gb_ai_wsq_scene IN ('BOTH', 'MINIAPP')
AND sq.gb_ai_wsq_scene IN ('BOTH', 'DESKTOP')
AND sq.gb_ai_wsq_scene = 'BOTH'
ORDER BY sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_sort ASC, sq.gb_ai_wsq_topic_id ASC, sq.gb_ai_wsq_sort ASC
